question:
A textile dyeing factory has 3 dyeing vats. The fabric must be dyed in each vat in order: vat 1, vat 2, vat 3. The factory needs to dye five batches of fabric of different sizes. The time required to dye batch i in vat j, denoted as $s_{ij}$ in hours, is given in the matrix below:

$$
\left(\begin{array}{ccc}
3 & 1 & 1 \\
2 & 1.5 & 1 \\
3 & 1.2 & 1.3 \\
2 & 2 & 2 \\
2.1 & 2 & 3
\end{array}\right)
$$

Arrange the dyeing operations in the vats to minimize the end time of the last batch.

candidates.code:
# ==============================================================================
# MODULE: Flow-shop scheduling of 5 fabric batches through 3 ordered dyeing vats
#         Minimise the makespan (end time of the last batch).
#
# DECISION VARIABLES
#   s[i, j]  : start time of batch i on vat j            (i in BATCH, j in VAT)
#              domain: NonNegativeReals, bounds (0, None)
#   Cmax     : makespan = completion time of last operation
#              domain: NonNegativeReals, bounds (0, None)
#   y[i, k, j] : binary, = 1 if batch i precedes batch k on vat j (i != k)
#              domain: Binary
#
# OBJECTIVE (words)
#   Minimise Cmax, the time at which the final batch finishes its last vat.
#
# CONSTRAINTS (numbered, with source sentence)
#   (1) Flow / precedence within a batch: "The fabric must be dyed in each vat
#       in order: vat 1, vat 2, vat 3."
#         s[i, j+1] >= s[i, j] + p[i, j]      for all i, j < last vat
#   (2) Disjunctive non-overlap on each vat: two batches cannot be dyed at the
#       same time in the same vat.  Linearised with big-M and binaries y.
#         s[k, j] >= s[i, j] + p[i, j] - M*(1 - y[i,k,j])
#         s[i, j] >= s[k, j] + p[k, j] - M*    y[i,k,j]
#   (3) Makespan definition: "minimize the end time of the last batch."
#         Cmax >= s[i, last_vat] + p[i, last_vat]   for all i
# ==============================================================================

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # processing times p[i][j] : hours for batch i on vat j
    "p": {
        (0, 0): 3.0, (0, 1): 1.0, (0, 2): 1.0,
        (1, 0): 2.0, (1, 1): 1.5, (1, 2): 1.0,
        (2, 0): 3.0, (2, 1): 1.2, (2, 2): 1.3,
        (3, 0): 2.0, (3, 1): 2.0, (3, 2): 2.0,
        (4, 0): 2.1, (4, 1): 2.0, (4, 2): 3.0,
    },
    "batches": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
    "vats": [0, 1, 2],
    "big_M": 1000.0,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    batches = d["batches"]
    vats = d["vats"]
    p = d["p"]
    M = d["big_M"]
    last_vat = vats[-1]

    # ordered pairs (i, k) with i != k, used for sequencing binaries
    pairs = [(i, k) for i in batches for k in batches if i != k]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.BATCH = pyo.Set(initialize=batches)
    model.VAT = pyo.Set(initialize=vats)
    model.PAIR = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)

    # ---- decision variables -------------------------------------------------
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.BATCH, model.VAT,
                      within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    model.Cmax = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.PAIR, model.VAT, within=pyo.Binary)

    # ---- (1) flow / precedence within each batch ----------------------------
    def flow_rule(m, i, j):
        if j == last_vat:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        return m.s[i, j + 1] >= m.s[i, j] + p[(i, j)]

    model.flow = pyo.Constraint(model.BATCH, model.VAT, rule=flow_rule)

    # ---- (2) disjunctive non-overlap on each vat ----------------------------
    def seq_rule(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[k, j] >= m.s[i, j] + p[(i, j)] - M * (1 - m.y[i, k, j])

    model.seq1 = pyo.Constraint(model.PAIR, model.VAT, rule=seq_rule)

    def seq_rule2(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[i, j] >= m.s[k, j] + p[(k, j)] - M * m.y[i, k, j]

    model.seq2 = pyo.Constraint(model.PAIR, model.VAT, rule=seq_rule2)

    # ---- (3) makespan definition --------------------------------------------
    def makespan_rule(m, i):
        return m.Cmax >= m.s[i, last_vat] + p[(i, last_vat)]

    model.makespan = pyo.Constraint(model.BATCH, rule=makespan_rule)

    # ---- objective ----------------------------------------------------------
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.Cmax, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return model

        dimen=2,
    )

    # start time of batch i on vat j
    model.start = pyo.Var(
        model.BATCHES, model.VATS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals
    )
    # makespan (end time of last batch)

    # before[i,k,j] = 1 if batch i precedes batch k on vat j
    model.before = pyo.Var(
        model.PAIRS, model.VATS, within=pyo.Binary
    )

    # Objective: minimize the end time of the last batch
    def obj_rule(m_):
        return m_.makespan

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Precedence: batch i finishes on vat j before starting on vat j+1
    def precedence_rule(m_, i, j):
        if j < m - 1:
            return m_.start[i, j + 1] >= m_.start[i, j] + s[i][j]
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip

    model.precedence = pyo.Constraint(
        model.BATCHES, model.VATS, rule=precedence_rule
    )

    # Disjunctive no-overlap on each vat
    def no_overlap_rule(m_, i, k, j):
        return m_.start[k, j] >= m_.start[i, j] + s[i][j] - M * (1 - m_.before[i, k, j])

    model.no_overlap = pyo.Constraint(
        model.PAIRS, model.VATS, rule=no_overlap_rule
    )

    # Makespan: last batch finishes on the final vat
    def makespan_rule(m_, i):
        return m_.makespan >= m_.start[i, m - 1] + s[i][m - 1]

    model.makespan_def = pyo.Constraint(
        model.BATCHES, rule=makespan_rule
    )

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "num_vats": 3,
    "num_batches": 5,
    # s[i][j] : vat index j in 0..2, batch i in 0..4  (hours)
    "s": [
        [3.0, 1.0, 1.0],
        [2.0, 1.5, 1.0],
        [3.0, 1.2, 1.3],
        [2.0, 2.0, 2.0],
        [2.1, 2.0, 3.0],
    ],
    "bigM": 1000.0,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    nB = d["num_batches"]
    nV = d["num_vats"]

    model.I = pyo.RangeSet(1, nB)          # batches
    model.J = pyo.RangeSet(1, nV)          # vats (in processing order)
    model.P = pyo.RangeSet(1, nB)          # sequence positions

    # x[i,p] = 1 if batch i is scheduled in position p
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.I, model.P, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # c[p,j] = completion time of the batch at position p on vat j
    model.c = pyo.Var(model.P, model.J, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Cmax = makespan (end time of last batch on last vat)
    model.Cmax = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---- Objective: minimise makespan ----
    def obj_rule(m):
        return m.Cmax
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- Each batch assigned to exactly one position ----
    def assign_batch_rule(m, i):
        return sum(m.x[i, p] for p in m.P) == 1
    model.assign_batch = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=assign_batch_rule)

    # ---- Each position holds exactly one batch ----
    def assign_pos_rule(m, p):
        return sum(m.x[i, p] for i in m.I) == 1
    model.assign_pos = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=assign_pos_rule)

    # ---- Processing / flow constraints ----
    # For position p:
    #   j == 1 (first vat):  c[p,1] >= sum_i s[i,1] * x[i,p]
    #   j  > 1:              c[p,j] >= c[p,j-1] + sum_i s[i,j] * x[i,p]
    #                                        (job precedence: vat j after vat j-1)
    #                          c[p,j] >= c[p-1,j] + sum_i s[i,j] * x[i,p]   for p>1
    #                                        (machine: no overlap within vat j)
    def proc_rule(m, p, j):
        proc_time = sum(d["s"][i - 1][j - 1] * m.x[i, p] for i in m.I)
        rhs = proc_time
        if j > 1:
            rhs = rhs + m.c[p, j - 1]
        if p > 1:
            rhs = rhs + m.c[p - 1, j]
        return m.c[p, j] >= rhs
    model.proc = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.J, rule=proc_rule)

    # Start lower bound for first position first vat tied to zero baseline:
    #   c[1,1] >= sum_i s[i,1]*x[i,1]  already covered above (p=1, j=1)
    #   but we must disconnect c[1,1] from c[0,*] — handled by "if p>1".

    # ---- Makespan definition ----
    # Cmax >= completion of the batch scheduled last (position nB) on the final vat
    def makespan_rule(m):
        return m.Cmax >= m.c[nB, nV]
    model.makespan = pyo.Constraint(rule=makespan_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):

    batches = list(range(1, d["num_batches"] + 1))
    vats = list(range(1, d["num_vats"] + 1))
    # ordered pairs (i<k) used to define precedence binaries per vat
    pairs = [(i, k) for i in batches for k in batches if i < k]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=batches, ordered=True)
    model.J = pyo.Set(initialize=vats, ordered=True)
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)

    def proc(i, j):
        return d["proc_time"][i - 1][j - 1]

    M = d["big_M"]

    # ---------- Variables ----------
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.I, model.J, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.Cmax = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # y[i,k,j] = 1 if batch i is processed before batch k on vat j (i<k)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, model.J, within=pyo.Binary)

    # ---------- Objective ----------
    def obj_rule(m):
        return m.Cmax

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---------- Constraints ----------

    # Precedence: each batch must complete vat j before starting vat j+1
    def prec_rule(m, i, j):
        # only for j = 1..num_vats-1
        return m.s[i, j + 1] >= m.s[i, j] + proc(i, j)

    model.prec = pyo.Constraint(
        model.I,
        range(1, d["num_vats"]),
        rule=prec_rule,
    )

    # Non-overlap on each vat (disjunctive, either i before k or k before i)
    def nooverlap_ik(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[i, j] + proc(i, j) <= m.s[k, j] + M * (1 - m.y[i, k, j])

    def nooverlap_ki(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[k, j] + proc(k, j) <= m.s[i, j] + M * m.y[i, k, j]

    model.nooverlap_ik = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.J, rule=nooverlap_ik)
    model.nooverlap_ki = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.J, rule=nooverlap_ki)

    # Makespan references last vat (vat num_vats) finish time
    last_j = d["num_vats"]

    def makespan_rule(m, i):
        return m.Cmax >= m.s[i, last_j] + proc(i, last_j)

    model.makespan = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=makespan_rule)

    return model

    # ordered pairs of batches (i < k) for disjunctive constraints

    )

    def makespan_rule(m, i):

    m.K = pyo.Set(

    PM_list = [(i, k, j) for (i, k) in pair_list

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=trans_list, dimen=2)

    "num_vats": 3,

    "num_batches": 5,

    "proc_time": {

        (4, 1): 2.0, (4, 2): 2.0, (4, 3): 2.0,
        (5, 1): 2.1, (5, 2): 2.0, (5, 3): 3.0,
    },
    # Big-M: safe upper bound on any start time (sum of all processing times)
    "big_M": 3.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 2.0 + 1.5 + 1.0 + 3.0 + 1.2 + 1.3
             + 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.1 + 2.0 + 3.0,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    batches = list(range(1, d["num_batches"] + 1))
    vats = list(range(1, d["num_vats"] + 1))
    # ordered pairs of distinct batches used for the disjunctive constraints
    pairs = [(i, k) for i in batches for k in batches if i < k]
    # (batch, vat) transitions: consecutive vats 1->2 and 2->3
    vat_pairs = [(j, j + 1) for j in vats[:-1]]

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.I = pyo.Set(initialize=batches)          # batches
    m.J = pyo.Set(initialize=vats)             # vats (machines, in order)
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)   # unordered batch pairs
    m.VP = pyo.Set(initialize=vat_pairs, dimen=2)  # consecutive vat pairs

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # start time of batch i on vat j  (hours, >= 0)
    m.s = pyo.Var(m.I, m.J, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # y[i,k,j] = 1 if batch i is processed before batch k on vat j
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.P, m.J, domain=pyo.Binary)
    # makespan: end time of the last batch
    m.Cmax = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraints
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # (a) Flow precedence: batch i must finish vat j before starting vat j+1
    def flow_rule(m, i, j, jn):
        return m.s[i, jn] >= m.s[i, j] + d["proc_time"][(i, j)]

    m.flow = pyo.Constraint(m.I, m.VP, rule=flow_rule)

    # (b) Disjunctive non-overlap on each vat j for each pair (i,k)
    #     if y=1 : i before k ; if y=0 : k before i
    def seq1_rule(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[k, j] >= m.s[i, j] + d["proc_time"][(i, j)] \
               - d["big_M"] * (1 - m.y[i, k, j])

    def seq2_rule(m, i, k, j):
        return m.s[i, j] >= m.s[k, j] + d["proc_time"][(k, j)] \
               - d["big_M"] * m.y[i, k, j]

    m.seq1 = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.J, rule=seq1_rule)
    m.seq2 = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.J, rule=seq2_rule)

    # (c) Makespan: last batch finishes on the final vat
    def makespan_rule(m, i):
        return m.Cmax >= m.s[i, d["num_vats"]] + d["proc_time"][(i, d["num_vats"])]

    m.makespan = pyo.Constraint(m.I, rule=makespan_rule)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: minimize end time of the last batch
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=m.Cmax, sense=pyo.minimize)

    return m
